sn12.1:1.2: The Exalted One was once staying near Savatthi at the Jeta Grove in Anathapindika's Park.
sn12.1:1.3: And there the Exalted One addressed the monks, saying:—
sn12.1:1.7: “I will teach you, monks, the causal law.
sn12.1:1.8: Listen to it, give your minds thoroughly and I will speak.”
sn12.1:2.2: Conditioned by ignorance activities come to pass;
sn12.1:2.12: conditioned by birth old age-and-death, grief, lamenting, suffering, sorrow. despair come to pass.
sn12.1:2.13: Such is the uprising of this entire mass of ill.
sn12.1:3.1: But from the utter fading away and ceasing of ignorance (comes] ceasing of activities;
sn12.1:3.2: from ceasing of activities ceasing of consciousness;
sn12.1:3.3: from ceasing of consciousness ceasing of name-and-shape;
sn12.1:3.4: from ceasing of name-and-shape ceasing of sense;
sn12.1:3.5: from ceasing of sense ceasing of contact;
sn12.1:3.6: from ceasing of contact ceasing of feeling;
sn12.1:3.7: from ceasing of feeling ceasing of craving;
sn12.1:3.8: from ceasing of craving ceasing of grasping;
sn12.1:3.9: from ceasing of grasping ceasing of becoming;
sn12.1:3.10: from ceasing of becoming ceasing of birth;
sn12.1:3.11: from ceasing of birth old age-and-death, grief, lamenting, suffering, sorrow, despair cease.
sn12.1:3.12: Such is the ceasing of this entire mass of ill.”
sn12.1:3.13: It is the Exalted One who had spoken this.
sn12.1:3.14: Pleased in mind those monks took delight in the saying of the Exalted One.
